description: We are a team of students interested in space, science, technology, and innovation. Our project idea is The Earth Information Jukebox, which aims to make Earth science information easy and fun to understand. We are interested in learning new technologies, developing creative ideas, and working together as a team. We welcome participants who are interested in coding, designing, research, presentation, and problem-solving. Join our team to explore, learn, and create something innovative together!
summary:
# GEDI Forest Height Explorer

GEDI Forest Height Explorer is an educational website developed to explain how NASA's Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) mission helps us understand and monitor forest height using advanced LiDAR technology from the International Space Station (ISS).

Our website provides an interactive forest height calculator that allows users to explore different tree canopy heights and understand forest classifications. It also explains how satellite-based forest observations contribute to environmental protection, climate change awareness, carbon storage analysis, biodiversity conservation, and ecosystem sustainability.

This project addresses the challenge by making NASA's GEDI mission and forest monitoring concepts easier to understand and accessible to everyone through a simple, interactive, and user-friendly platform.

The project is important because forests play a vital role in maintaining Earth's ecological balance. By improving awareness of forest monitoring and conservation, our website encourages people to understand the importance of protecting forests and building a sustainable future.
details: The GEDI Forest Height Explorer is a web-based project designed to explain how NASA's GEDI satellite uses laser technology to measure forest height and study forest structure. It provides information about forest conservation, climate protection, and biodiversity. The website also includes a tree-height converter to convert metres into feet.
